artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan extending lean-mcp-preflight-check.sh with server reachability detection and a --dispatch-block mode, injecting a task_type-agnostic <lean-readiness-context> block into every dispatch file, plus test coverage on both sides and two context-doc gaps.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent system, a per-extension manifest `hooks.preflight` registration is resolved by `skill_run_extension_hook` -> `skill_get_extension_dir($task_type)`, i.e. the SINGLE extension that declares that exact task_type. A hook registered by extension A therefore never fires for a task whose task_type is declared by extension B, even when the project materially belongs to A's domain (observed: a `formal`-typed task in a Lean 4 project never reaches any lean-owned preflight hook). Separately, `/orchestrate` routes agents directly via command-route-agent.sh and never executes the domain SKILL.md bodies at all, so an inline Stage 2 call inside a domain skill is only reached by a direct /research|/plan|/implement invocation. The task-type-agnostic alternative, when a probe must fire for a project CLASS rather than a task_type: call it unconditionally from `orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh` (which every dispatch passes through, with CWD at the target repo root) and let the probe self-gate on directory detection, following the `deploy_freshness_context` / `memory_context` / `lit_context` precedent of a conditionally-computed, tagged block emitted only when non-empty so an inactive build stays byte-identical.
